messages.speaker: Priya Shah
messages.text: For feature flags, I recommend choosing LaunchDarkly because audit support is ready.

messages.speaker: Hannah Lee
messages.text: Approved: choose LaunchDarkly for feature flags now.

sections.heading: Decision
sections.text: Final decision: use LaunchDarkly for feature flags.

sections.heading: Rejected Alternatives
sections.text: ConfigCat was cheaper, but migration would take longer because we would need to rebuild the flag evaluation wrapper.

sections.heading: Tradeoff
sections.text: The tradeoff with LaunchDarkly is higher monthly spend.
